decision_rule: remediable if macro <= 1.10x matched-budget unconstrained reference

decision.conclusion: Widening the bottleneck (8.0091 -> 7.3232) and tripling budget (8.0091 -> 7.0706) each help, but neither approaches the unconstrained child (4.9024/4.0137). The mandatory-use pathway is intrinsically lossy at these budgets.

outcome.label: Final negative for this pairing/interface family at this scale
outcome.rationale: Campaigns 3-6 jointly show: unconstrained bridges ignore the donor; mandatory bridges use it but destroy too much host information; width/placement do not fix this; and capacity controls prove the forced pathway itself cannot match unconstrained performance with random sectors.
